Solutions | Salesforce 
Incorta for Salesforce
Understand your customers better, boost sales, run smarter marketing, 
and build stronger relationships - all from one powerful platform.
Get a Live Demo
Turn your Salesforce data into faster decisions
Sales, marketing, finance, and support teams often struggle to analyze Salesforce data quickly, all in one place - delaying the insights that drive results. 
With Incorta, you get instant access to 100% of your Salesforce data - and ready-to-use prebuilt dashboards - so you can quickly answer questions like: 
‍
Do we have enough pipeline to hit our forecast?
Are our marketing campaigns generating quality leads?
Which deals are most likely to close - and why?
Is our sales data accurate and up to date?
Get more from your Salesforce data with Incorta
Get a Live Demo
01
Get instant access to all your Salesforce data
Incorta connects directly to Salesforce - no complex data modeling or transformations required. With Direct Data Mapping®, you get real-time access to your CRM, sales, and financial data, and can build high-performance reports on your own.
02
Combine all your data for better insights
Easily bring other data sources into your Salesforce analysis, so you can: 
Enrich reports with new dimensions and deliver executive-ready insights 
Track sales team productivity
Forecast revenue using historical trends
Make decisions with complete, up-to-the-minute metrics
03
Use our pre-built dashboards for faster Salesforce analytics
Skip the setup and start getting answers right away. 
With our library of prebuilt Data Apps for Salesforce, you get ready-to-use dashboards for instant, customizable analytics organized by team and role, so you can start getting real value from your Salesforce data immediately.
